title: Target framework mismatch

sourceOfTruth.rule: Use the targetFramework from the matching Knowledge/versions entry and confirm package compatibility from restore output.

symptoms: Project is not compatible with the current target framework.
Core package supports a newer target framework than the client project.
investigation: Find every .csproj TargetFramework or TargetFrameworks value.
Confirm the target Core packages expose assemblies for the required TFM.
patchRules: Update all projects in the solution to the required target framework.
Keep framework versions consistent across API, services, repositories, tests, WebJobs, and tooling projects.
For Core 9.x, update build pipeline dotnet version to 10.0 where present.
antiPatterns: Do not update only the project that first reported NU1201.
Do not leave mixed net8.0, net9.0, and net10.0 projects unless the solution already has a deliberate multi-targeting pattern.

successCriteria: No project references an older incompatible target framework.
